# LibreOffice Writer Interface Description

## System and Application Header

- **Operating System Environment**: Linux desktop environment
- **Application Title Bar**: 
  - Left: "LibreOffice Writer" icon
  - Center: "Opthalmologist_Prescription.docx - LibreOffice Writer"
  - Right: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons
- **System Tray**: 
  - Date and time: "Oct 22 19:49"
  - Notification bell icon
- **Desktop Environment**: "Activities" button on the top-left corner

## Desktop Environment Sidebar

- **Left Vertical Dock**:
  - Google Chrome icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon (currently active)
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - File manager icon
  - Software center icon
  - Help icon (question mark)
  - Trash icon
  - Grid icon for application launcher

## LibreOffice Writer Menu Bar

- **Main Menu Options**:
  - File
  - Edit
  - View
  - Insert
  - Format
  - Styles
  - Table
  - Form
  - Tools
  - Window
  - Help

## LibreOffice Writer Toolbar

- **Primary Toolbar**:
  - New document button
  - Open document button
  - Save document button
  - Print button
  - Export as PDF button
  - Cut, Copy, Paste buttons
  - Undo, Redo buttons
  - Find and Replace button
  - Font color selector
  - Font size selector (currently set to 0.01")
  - Text alignment buttons
  - List formatting buttons
  - Text formatting buttons (bold, italic, underline)
  - Font style selector
  - Character formatting tools
  - Table insertion button
  - Special characters button (Ω)
  - Link insertion button
  - Comment button
  - Page layout buttons
  - Drawing tools (pen, shapes, lines)
  - Object insertion tools

## LibreOffice Writer Status Bar

- **Document Information**:
  - Page number: "Page 1 of 1"
  - Word and character count: "20 words, 169 characters"
  - Page style: "Default Page Style"
- **Document Metrics**:
  - Page dimensions: "2.98 x 0.30"
  - Zoom level: "60%"
  - View scale: "0.26 / 2.13"
- **Navigation Controls**:
  - Page navigation buttons
  - Zoom slider
  - Zoom in/out buttons

## LibreOffice Writer Document Area

- **Document Content**:
  - Document title: "Opthalmologist_Prescription.docx"
  - Document layout: Prescription form template
- **Document Layout Elements**:
  - **Header Section**:
    - "Doctor's Name" field with "Specialist in" subfield
    - Medical symbol (Caduceus) on the right
  - **Patient Information Fields**:
    - "Name:" field with horizontal line for input
    - "Age:" field with horizontal line for input
    - "Gender:" field with horizontal line for input
    - "Date:" field with horizontal line for input
  - **Prescription Area**:
    - Large rectangular area for prescription content
  - **Signature Section**:
    - "Signature:" field with horizontal line for signature
  - **Hospital Information Section**:
    - "Hospital Name" field
    - "Address" field with subfields: "Line, Street Name, Country, Pin Code"

## LibreOffice Writer Sidebar

- **Right Vertical Sidebar**:
  - **Sidebar Toggle Button**: Three horizontal lines
  - **Sidebar Icons**:
    - Document properties icon
    - Styles icon
    - Navigator icon
    - Comments icon
    - Object properties icon
    - Font properties icon

## LibreOffice Writer Notification Bar

- **Top Notification Bar**:
  - Two blue notification banners
  - First banner: "Help us make LibreOffice even better!" with "Get involved" button and close button (X)
  - Second banner: "Your donations support our worldwide community." with "Donate" button and close button (X)
